scope: One member warm Profile save failure and recovery branch in the owned native side panel.

required_inputs: panel from the existing runNativeSidepanelQa callback
origin from the runner's validated Supabase URL
email and original Preferred value from the runner's verified member identity and initial Profile read
journal from createOwnedWriteJournal for a first-save row owned by this run
state, fillPreferred, clickProfileHeader and openProfile from the existing Profile runner
runner_integration.placement: After member first-save ownership is established and before the extension reload. Keep the returned case receipt provisional until the runner's outer owned-row deletion and absence verification complete.
runner_integration.cleanup_interface: The case disables its CDP Fetch interception, discards a failed unsaved draft, and uses journal.save plus reopen verification to restore the owned row's original Preferred value after any successful retry. If Fetch.disable fails, its handler stays attached in pass-through mode so later reads can continue, and the case fails explicitly. The runner remains responsible for the exact conditional DELETE of a newly created row and verified restoration of original row absence; only then may it mark T26 passed. A failed journal reconciliation leaves the durable pending intent for the runner's cleanup and fails acceptance.
runner_integration.precondition: Run only in the designated member case after a run-owned first-save row exists. A preexisting row has no owned-write journal and is deliberately refused.

forcing_observations: One request-stage intercepted POST with the exact Supabase origin, users profile header, verified owner ID, organization ID and synthetic Preferred value is failed before it reaches the server; unrelated requests continue.
The real Profile UI retains the synthetic Preferred draft, shows a nonempty failure, ends saving, and enables Save again.
With interception removed, the real Save persists the draft through the owned-write journal; reopening Profile reads the same value.

The original Preferred value is saved through the journal and reread after reopening. The case receipt says row absence remains unverified until the runner's outer cleanup deletes the row and checks its prior absence.
source_basis: src/features/profile/ProfileView.tsx Preferred, error and Save controls
limits: No native UI, backend write, local build or release was permitted in this lane. Runtime behavior and exact row-absence restoration remain unverified until the root integrates and executes the case.
This module relies on existing runner-private Profile UI helpers being passed as callbacks; the shared runner was not edited while another Profile run was active.

peer_07ed1a70_resolution.request_scope: The failed request must match the journal-verified owner ID and organization ID, the synthetic Preferred value, users Content-Profile header, exact origin/route, and POST method. Only the first matching request is failed; a second is continued and makes the case fail.
peer_07ed1a70_resolution.disable_failure: On Fetch.disable rejection, the listener remains attached in pass-through mode and the case fails with a fixed error code. A later stop can retry disable; cleanup reads are continued while interception remains armed.
peer_07ed1a70_resolution.receipt_scope: The case reports restored owned-row value after journal verification but leaves original_absence_verified=false and provisional status. The runner must verify conditional deletion and original row absence before promotion.
